The notes on this topic are split across these pages:

- [Partial Derivatives and Gradients](vector-calculus-gradients.qmd):
  [partial derivatives](vector-calculus-gradients.qmd#def-partial-derivative),
  [gradients](vector-calculus-gradients.qmd#def-vector-derivative),
  [linear approximation](vector-calculus-gradients.qmd#def-linear-approximation-vector),
  and [level sets](vector-calculus-gradients.qmd#def-level-set).
- [Jacobians and Derivative Rules](vector-calculus-derivative-rules.qmd):
  [Jacobian matrices](vector-calculus-derivative-rules.qmd#def-jacobian-matrix),
  derivatives of linear forms and [quadratic forms](linear-algebra-special-matrices.qmd#def-quadratic-form), and the vector chain rule.
- [Second Partial Derivatives and the Hessian](vector-calculus-hessian.qmd):
  [Hessian matrices](vector-calculus-hessian.qmd#def-hessian),
  [continuity in several variables](vector-calculus-hessian.qmd#def-continuous-several),
  and the [symmetry of the Hessian](vector-calculus-hessian.qmd#thm-hessian-symmetric).

A link to a section, theorem or definition on this page from before the split
goes on to the page that now holds it.

# Further reading {#sec-additional-resources}

- @marsden2013vector
  is a standard textbook on multivariable and vector calculus.
  It covers differentiation of functions of several variables, multiple integrals,
  line and surface integrals, and the theorems of Green, Gauss, and Stokes.
- @petersen2012matrix
  is a free desk reference that collects matrix identities.
  Its chapter on derivatives lists derivatives of vector and matrix expressions,
  such as the linear forms and [quadratic forms](linear-algebra-special-matrices.qmd#def-quadratic-form) on the [Jacobians and Derivative Rules](vector-calculus-derivative-rules.qmd) page.
- @problifesavercalc
  The [partial derivative](vector-calculus-gradients.qmd#def-partial-derivative) review exercises and worked solutions on the [Partial Derivatives and Gradients](vector-calculus-gradients.qmd) page are adapted from this supplemental review chapter. <!-- check-term-links: allow: worked solutions are answers to exercises -->

-   @wp:gradient --- the gradient

See also the [Linear Algebra and Vector Calculus
further reading](linear-algebra.qmd#sec-additional-resources).

- [Hua Zhou](https://hua-zhou.github.io/)'s [lecture notes for "UCLA Biostat 216 - Mathematical Methods for Biostatistics" (2023 Fall)](https://ucla-biostat-216.github.io/2023fall/schedule/schedule.html)
- [Neural Networks](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLZHQObOWTQDNU6R1_67000Dx_ZCJB-3pi)
  is a YouTube playlist by Grant Sanderson (3Blue1Brown);
  its chapters on gradient descent and backpropagation calculus visually illustrate
  how gradients of multivariate cost functions are computed and used for optimization.
